purpose: Measure whether direct all-bit scalar prediction transfers across complete toy generators and curves before considering an explicit mechanism search.
freeze_sequence: commit implementation, configuration, controls, metrics, and stop rules
generate and independently validate the exact 10-curve-per-rung catalog
generate physically separate development and blind shards and independently replay every record
bind and commit the compact catalog, manifest, validations, and authorized preregistration while raw shards remain ignored
select one architecture on 12- and 16-bit development data and lock its identity so 20-bit results cannot reselect it
run the unchanged 20-bit reference confirmation and all controls without opening any blind shard
commit the selection ledger, selection result, and blind-authorization recipe
only then open blind shards for the frozen retrained scaling ladder

design.metric_baseline: exact per-record public scalar-bit prior for d uniform in [1,n-1]

allowed: observed behavior on the exact listed toy curves
presence or absence of transfer across held-out generators and curves
bounded null for the listed models and compute budget
forbidden: a native Research Engine supported or falsified outcome
treating model weights as an attack mechanism

positive_escalation_gate: independently verified recovery on blind 24-bit curves
consistent transfer across both curves and generators
decreasing K50 divided by sqrt(group order)
upper 95% confidence bound on log2 total-work slope below 0.5
explicit executable mechanism extracted from the model
new immutable candidate snapshot and later owner authorization
